name: FoxInbox for Divi
author: GlossyFox

sections.description:
FoxInbox for Divi stores new submissions from the native Divi Contact Form module in your WordPress dashboard.

  • Administrator-only inbox with search and unread count.
  • Submission details with all processed custom fields.
  • Internal notes and follow-up checkboxes: Emailed, Called, Left voicemail, Awaiting response, and Resolved.
  • CSV export, trash, restore, and bulk deletion.
  • No external service or license key required.

Uses the documented et_pb_contact_form_submit hook, available since Divi 4.13.1. Verify operation with your installed Divi version, particularly Divi 5. Divi is not included.

This is an independent plugin by GlossyFox Web Design. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elegant Themes. Divi is a trademark of its respective owner.

Only new submissions after activation are captured. Submissions with errors reported by Divi are skipped. Saving a submission does not confirm email delivery. CSV exports original submission data; internal notes and follow-up statuses are not exported.

Entries and notes remain on deactivation and deletion. Manage retention and privacy requests through the administrator inbox. This plugin does not collect IP addresses or browser fingerprints, and does not integrate with the WordPress personal data exporter or eraser.
sections.installation:
1. Upload foxinbox-for-divi.zip through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate FoxInbox for Divi.
  3. Open FoxInbox for Divi in the dashboard and submit a test contact form.

If upgrading from Form Inbox for Divi, Divi Inbox, or Divi Entries, deactivate that plugin before activating this renamed package. Existing entries, notes, read states, and follow-up checkboxes are retained because the data keys are unchanged. Do not activate both packages together.
sections.faq:
Does this recover old submissions?

No. It captures new submissions after activation.

Do the follow-up checkboxes send email or make calls?

No. They record actions taken by your team. Notes and read status are shared by administrators.

1.4.0

  • Renamed to FoxInbox for Divi with the slug foxinbox-for-divi.
  • Automatic read tracking now requires a POST request, entry-specific nonce, administrator permissions, and a valid inbox entry.
  • Preserved existing submissions, notes, and read states.

1.3.3

  • Corrected the Tested up to header to use the required major.minor format.

1.3.2

  • Added Tested up to: 7.1 based on the reported test site version.
  • CSV downloads now output RFC 4180 rows directly without filesystem calls.

1.3.1

  • Renamed the plugin and package to FoxInbox for Divi.
  • Updated interface labels and CSV filenames.
  • Preserved existing entry data keys for upgrades.

1.3.0

  • Added the inbox branding.

1.2.0

  • Added internal notes and follow-up tracking.

1.1.0

  • Added unread notifications and a visible CSV export button.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
